answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same plot, and forging a tag costs more than the reward per epoch. Each agent must stake a physical copper token tagged with its orchard plot coordinates, verified against regional karst geology records. Attackers must acquire and defend scarce real-world plots, making mass sock-puppet registration economically irrational while honest agents recover stake on exit. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
